info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Etas-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments ETA API provides clients with real-time information on estimated arrival times for various logistics shipments. It allows businesses to track and manage shipment schedules, ensuring efficient supply chain operations. Users can query the system to retrieve ETA details for specific shipments, helping logistics managers and customer service teams provide accurate updates to stakeholders. This API is essential for organizations aiming to enhance their shipping transparency and improve customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated arrival times for shipments.
get.description: This endpoint provides the estimated arrival times (ETA) for shipments based on current data and projections. Use this information to inform customers about when to expect their shipments.

requestBody.description: This object contains the necessary parameters for retrieving the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for shipments. Please ensure that all required fields are accurately filled to obtain correct ETA data.
